title: Statutes of Frauds — comparison problems
summary: The problems compare state writing requirements and vary agreements for services, land-related transactions, and other undertakings.
notes: For each exact fact pattern, first identify the governing state text, then its coverage, the relevant duration or interest, the sufficiency of any writing, and an applicable exception. A hotel scenario and variations across jurisdictions test whether the traditional categories have been changed. The unprovided SEL or SUPP text should not be replaced by a remembered statute.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 378–379. Open assigned page 378.
